count_source: Author-released post-QC integer RNA counts, exactly matched to all 13 released MTX matrices; not integrated assay or log expression. All 31944 released genes retained; author-excluded nuclei/genes cannot be recovered.
cell_calling: Reuse author released nuclei; input is already post-QC, not full raw droplets. No EmptyDrops, new ambient correction, normalization, imputation or integration applied to delivered counts.
author_QC: Published methods: UMI (500,50000), detected genes (300,7000), mitochondrial and ribosomal fractions <.05, genes detected in >=3 nuclei; author percent.mito is a fraction. Existing restrictions inherited, not claimed as newly applied.
doublet_model: Author Scrublet >.35 and mixed-lineage filtering inherited. Supplemental scDblFinder only when a released sample has >=10 AND >=1% strict candidates with coherent mixed panels (same explicit multi-panel rule below). Model input: all released >=500-gene nuclei, including >5000 and high MT. dbr=NULL, dbr.per1k=.008 is a residual-screening heuristic; original capture loading/removals unavailable. Untriggered samples marked not_rerun_author_QC, missing scores explicitly allowed.
doublet_exclusion: scDblFinder doublet AND strong distinct-lineage pair: >=3 genes each with >=2 UMIs in both panels, both panel means log1p(CP10k) >= max(reference positive q10, negative q99), smaller/larger panel mean >=.25. Reference-derived project heuristic, not validated doublet probability. Weak >=1-UMI pairs are diagnostic/trigger only and do not exclude cells.
mixed_program_revision: Weak >=1-UMI pairs flagged 23815/53538 released strict nuclei and 307/2603 reference nuclei; cannot interpret those as doublets. Strong reference-derived programs flag 14 released strict nuclei, none author-CM. Superseded attempt1 outputs are archived, not accepted as final.
identity: SingleR trained on adapted common genes from adult LV nuclear reference; fixed reference donors held out. Cell type assigned only with pruned reference label and >=2 matched panel genes; otherwise Unknown.
CM_core: Author CM plus pruned and best reference label both Cardiomyocyte, >=2 CM panel genes, CM mean log1p(CP10k) >= every other panel, and (empirical reference-tail pass OR >=3 CM genes and >=.5 weighted CM-anchor neighbor support). Conflicting author/reference identities or coherent mixed programs remain pending unless supplemental caller also supports doublet exclusion.
CM_pending: Strict numeric, no strong doublet exclusion; author CM OR best reference CM OR >=3 CM panel genes and CM program dominates, but core identity rule fails. No forced relabeling of author/reference disagreements.
graph: Each cohort separately; log-CP10k diagnostic copy, 3000 HVGs, up to 40 PCs, 15 neighbors; no disease labels or test labels used. CM anchors require pruned CM plus >=3 CM panel genes and panel dominance. Neighborhood evidence is correlated contextual support, not independent confidence.
light: At most 20000 unique core nuclei, balanced allocations across available donors with fixed seed, never duplicated to fill a target
split_status: No train/test split assigned; external cohort status pending donor-overlap audit
replicate_policy: CL0412A and CL0412B share author Subject=CL0412. Treat as two released samples of one donor, not independent donors; never split across partitions. Exact technical versus tissue replicate mechanism not established.
author_annotation: Preserved as author_* metadata and compared with new identity calls; not a ground truth. Conflicting author CM labels remain in pending review when not supported as core.
scope: Each study saved separately. No disease differential expression, tokenization or training.
